name: Application Shell
description: HTML template plus the client and build-time server entries that hydrate or render the root App, which composes the single-page portfolio.

name: Page Sections
description: Top-level portfolio regions, from the navbar and hero through projects, FAQ and contact, that combine translated copy with shared content and reusable components.

name: Reusable UI Components
description: Shared building blocks for the sections, including scroll and text reveal animations, section headings, magnetic buttons, language and theme controls, the marquee and case-study workflow steps.

name: 3D Brain Scene
description: Lazy-loaded Three.js hero visual, with procedural brain geometry generated in a Web Worker, a WebGL scene with shader waves, and an error boundary that preserves the CSS orb fallback.

name: State & Hooks
description: React contexts for the URL-derived language and the document-attribute theme, plus custom hooks for active-section tracking and the cursor-following card glow.

name: Content & Translations
description: JSON-driven content model: language-independent site data, English, French and Spanish dictionaries, and the accessor modules that expose them to the React tree.

name: Styling
description: Global Deep Ocean stylesheet with dark and light design tokens, responsive breakpoints and reduced-motion handling, plus the minimal App-level body reset.

name: Build, SEO & Deployment
description: Vite, ESLint and npm tooling, the per-language pre-render script that emits SEO pages and sitemap, Vercel deployment settings, and public crawler, manifest and 404 files.

name: Documentation
description: Architecture reference in architect.md, the SEO/GEO audit, an earlier design review, and the unmodified Vite template README.
